about: Cases where KiCad's reference disagrees with the maker's datasheet, checked by hand against the datasheet text. A field listed here that fails against KiCad is scored as right (the report lists it as a reference erratum) when ours is what the datasheet says.

symbol_names.why: Diodes AH1806 datasheet (AH1806.pdf) p1 pinout and p2 pin table: SC59 (the -W package, p5) pin 1 VDD, pin 2 GND, pin 3 OUTPUT. KiCad's Sensor_Magnetic:AH1806-W has 2 OUTPUT, 3 GND.
